title: Assassination Classroom the Movie: Our Time Announces Fan Screening in the Philippines
content: Muse has announced that Assassination Classroom the Movie: Our Time will be premiering in the Philippines on May 9, 2026. The fan screening, which also celebrates the anime’s 10th anniversary, will be held at SM North EDSA, while the general screening will begin nationwide on May 13.
author: Anime Corner

title: Luffy Meets Luffy in One Piece Episode 1161 Preview
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1161, with Luffy finally meeting the notorious prince Loki of Elbaph. The anime returned after a 3-month break on April 5, with the Elbaph Island finally revealed. Yuichi Nakamura was previously revealed as the voice of Loki. The episode is titled “A Dangerous Deal!

title: Major Spanish Piracy Site Shut Down After Joint Effort Between Korean Webtoon Companies, Spanish Authorities
content: A coalition of major Korean webtoon platforms have successfully shut down one of the largest Spanish-language piracy sites, marking a significant milestone in global anti-piracy efforts.
author: ANN

title: 3 Dragon Ball Fights Gohan Should’ve Won
content: Akira Toriyama’s iconic Dragon Ball series redefined the Shonen demographic and continues to inspire creators to this day. The manga was adapted into two anime parts, with more than half of the story included in the sequel anime, Dragon Ball Z .
author: ComicBook

title: CJ ENM to Spin Off Webtoon Label Manhwa Family as Separate Entity
content: CJ ENM, one of the biggest entertainment conglomerates in Korea, is moving to spin off its webtoon production label Manhwa Family into a separate entity, as part of a broader strategy to focus on its core live-action content business.
author: ANN

title: 7 Shonen Jump Manga That Will Be Your Next Obsession
content: Shueisha’s Shonen Jump is renowned for producing some of the greatest manga ever created across its many branches. From the iconic Weekly Shonen Jump magazine to the digital-first Shonen Jump+ platform, its library houses hundreds of manga series.

title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 Releases Special Episode 4 Ending Video
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 has revealed the special ending movie video from Episode 4 (Episode 16 overall), which was released today . Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide.

title: Witch Hat Atelier Tops Spring 2026 Ranking for the First Time in Week 4
content: Witch Hat Atelier managed to win the Spring 2026 ranking for the first time Week 4, breaking Re:ZERO Season 4’s three-week streak . Studio BUG FILMS ( Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead ) is in charge of the animation, with Crunchyroll streaming the anime globally.
